title: Bills After the Company Test in Metering Service Referee Backbill Settlements
content:
A **Metering Service** referee backbill settlement may also reprice regular bills of the Electric Service Agreement whose billing period ended after the company test date, according to the meter installation's status and removal date.

**Removed after the company test.** Where the meter was removed from service after the company test date, the referee backbill settlement also reprices the regular bills whose billing period ended after the company test date and on or before the removal date, added to the bills counted back from the company test date, because the meter kept registering slow until it was taken out.

**Still in service.** Where the meter is still in service, the referee backbill settlement also reprices every regular bill whose billing period ended after the company test date, added to the bills counted back from the company test date.

**Every other case.** In every other case, a meter removed on or before the company test date among them, no bill whose billing period ended after the company test date is added.

## Timeline cases (hypothetical dates, company test on 15 April)

| Installation status and removal date | Bills ending after 15 April that are added |
|---|---|
| Removed on 20 June | Those ending after 15 April and on or before 20 June |
| Removed on 15 April | None, the removal is not after the company test date |
| In service | Every regular bill ending after 15 April |

With monthly bills ending on the last day of each month, a meter removed on 20 June adds the bills ending 30 April and 31 May; the bill ending 30 June ended after the removal date and is not added. A meter still in service on a handling date in late July adds the bills ending 30 April, 31 May and 30 June.
